cash.score-1.0.0: Legacy preserved: percent value >= 0.8 scores 1, > 0 scores 0.5, otherwise 0; missing ratio scores 0.5
cash.score-2.0.0: Percent value >= 80 scores 1, > 0 scores 0.5, otherwise 0; missing ratio scores 0.5
cash.financial_industries: Banks, securities, insurance and diversified financials use the same cash threshold; this is a heuristic with limited cross-industry comparability, not a claim of accounting equivalence
cash.profit_anomalies: Negative ROE remains excluded by V1 eligibility in both versions. Nonpositive EPS is flagged but does not change scores: EPS and ocf_to_profit do not prove the same profit denominator. Unavailable/zero/negative denominator cannot be reconstructed from this cache; no denominator validity is asserted. Null ratio remains null in observations and uses the explicit neutral scoring default

score_policy.leverage: Financial industries and missing debt ratio use neutral 0.5; other industries use <60%:1, <80%:0.5, otherwise 0
score_policy.missing: Raw and observed normalized factors remain null. scoring_factors and imputations expose every formula default; absent entire financial report uses component 0.3
score_policy.normalization: Full-market eligible universe, lower positive PE ranked within industry; sector strength uses all scanned stocks with >=5 members per industry. Subset requests never change the normalization universe
score_policy.ties: Legacy ordinal percentile ties retain full-market ts_code scan order; final equal-score ranks sort by ts_code

evaluation_limitations: Signals/factors must be supplied using information available at t close; evaluation does not validate their provenance or financial announcement filtering.
Calendar and dated market reads stop at asOf. Current stock_basic names/industry/listing metadata are not complete point-in-time history; historical industry references are approximate.

Opening buys at up-limit and closing sales at down-limit are conservatively blocked; suspension records block all trading that date, including partial-day suspensions. No order queue or intraday execution simulation.
A missing entry is never shifted to the next available bar. Missing exit price/limits remain unresolved; suspension/known down-limit exits defer by at most maxExitDelay exchange days.
Adjusted open-to-close returns approximate corporate actions using endpoint factors. Costs apply to both sides; slippage applies adversely to both sides.

Market/industry references are gross, uncosted endpoint observations of the signal-date listed universe, not investable portfolios. Partial references report priced-subset means and unresolved counts; no assumed delisting loss or zero return.
CSI300 is the gross price-index open-to-close return, not an ETF or total-return investment. References use the actual delayed exit date.
Statistics describe event/date return observations, not returns of a funded portfolio. Overlap and repeated stocks induce dependence; no significance or annualized Sharpe claim is made.
A-share T+1 resale requires horizon>=2 under the t+h exit convention; entry-day resale is rejected.

Non-overlap sensitivity greedily retains whole signal-date cohorts using every entered position, with exits still unconfirmed censored at asOf. No-entry cohorts remain counted but cannot create a holding interval. Returns use completed observations only, with unresolved denominators explicit; this does not remove dependence or selection bias.

future_observation.note: No future/live performance fabricated; new actual trading days must be accumulated after rule freeze and production acceptance.

paired_sensitivity.note: Common-comparable-event sensitivity computed read-only from the research DB event table by deploy/ashare/verify-research-summary.mjs. Descriptive only: the paired delta of an event present in both pools is zero by construction because the evaluation function and data cutoff are identical, so it cannot be read as a strategy return difference and is not used to tune parameters.

formation.label: DESCRIPTIVE_SENSITIVITY_ONLY: not a strategy return difference and not used to tune parameters
formation.interpretation: The paired delta is expected to be exactly zero because the evaluation function reads the same frozen prices for the same event under both versions. Differences between the two versions therefore come only from different pool membership, not from different return computation.
